name: ChartSeries
description: Represents a series of values in the specified chart.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of a ChartSeries instance based on the value of its associated field. Read-only String.

properties.name: PlotSeriesOn
properties.description: Returns or sets the axis to use for plotting the values of a series. Read/write AcValueAxis.

properties.name: DisplayDataLabel
properties.description: True if the data for a series is displayed in a label in addition to chart visualizations. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FillColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the fill color of a series visualization. Read/write String.

properties.name: BorderColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the border color of a series visualization. Read/write String.

properties.name: TrendlineOptions
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of trendline to render for a series. Read/write AcTrendlineOptions.

properties.name: TrendlineName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the series trendline if the trendline is visible. Read/write String.

properties.name: ComboChartType
properties.description: Returns or sets the chart type for the specified series. Read/write AcChartType.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.description: Returns or sets the legend display name of a series. Read/write String.

properties.name: DashType
properties.description: Returns or sets the line dash style of a series when the effective ChartType is acChartLine, acChartLineStacked, or acChartLineStacked100. Read/write AcDashType.

properties.name: LineWeight
properties.description: Returns or sets the line weight (thickness) for a series when its effective chart type is line-based. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MissingDataPolicy
properties.description: Returns or sets the plotting strategy of a series when its chart type is Line and values are missing. Read/write AcMissingDataPolicy.

properties.name: MarkerType
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker shape to use for data points when the effective chart type of a series is line-based. Read/write AcMarkerType.

properties.name: GridlinesType
properties.description: Returns or sets the gridlines type for a Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write AcGridlineType.

properties.name: DisplayBoxWhiskerDataPoints
properties.description: True if data points are displayed for a Box and Whisker Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayBoxWhiskerMeanMarker
properties.description: True if the mean marker is displayed for a Box and Whisker Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DataLabelPosition
properties.description: Returns or sets the data label position for Pie, Arc, and Doughnut Modern Charts (only available in Current Channel). Read/write AcDataLabelPosition.

properties.name: WordCloudShape
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape for a Word Cloud Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write AcWordCloudShape.

properties.name: WordCloudWordOrientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the word orientation for a Word Cloud Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write AcWordCloudWordOrientation.

properties.name: ShowWaterfallConnectorLines
properties.description: True if connector lines are displayed for a Waterfall Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowWaterfallTotal
properties.description: True if the total is displayed for a Waterfall Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowFunnelPercentages
properties.description: True if percentages are displayed for a Funnel Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PercentageDataLabelDecimalPlaces
properties.description: Returns or sets the demimal places for percentage data labels - only applicable to Pie, Arc, and Doughnut Modern Charts (only available in Current Channel). Read/write AcPercentageDataLabelDecimalPlaces.

properties.name: DataLabelDisplayFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets data label format for Pie, Arc, and Doughnut Modern Charts (only available in Current Channel). Read/write AcDataLabelDisplayFormat.

properties.name: SortOrderType
properties.description: Returns or sets the sort order type for series in a Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write AcSortOrderType.

properties.name: GridlinesColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the gridlines color for Modern Charts (only available in Current Channel). Read/write String.

properties.name: ParetoLineColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the line color for a Pareto Modern Chart (only available in Current Channel). Read/write String.
